get.summary: List all employees with their salary details
get.description: Paginated list of employees with their salary breakdown (basic, HRA, allowances, deductions, net salary, PF/ESI/TDS flags). Supports search, department, branch, and status filters. Group Admin can filter by company_id.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search by name, code, email, or mobile

get.summary: Get salary slip for an employee for a specific month
get.description: Returns a detailed salary slip for a given employee, month, and year. Includes employee details, company info, itemised earnings & deductions, and net pay summary. Admins (Group Admin, Company Admin, HR) can view any in-scope employee; employees with payroll.view.self can view their own.

404.description: No salary slip found for the given employee/month/year

get.description: Employee role only; returns payroll runs for the authenticated user's linked employee.

get.summary: Hour-based salary calculation for a month
get.description: Returns a day-by-day hour-based salary breakdown for every calendar day in the selected month (e.g. 31 rows for March). Each record includes attendance status (Present, Absent, Week Off, Holiday, Leave), punch times, per-day shift from shift history, and salary earnings. Includes monthly summary, period metadata, and shift assignment history.
Generates a company-branded PDF salary slip from live hour-based calculation. Does not require a finalized PayrollRun.
Lists employees with recorded payments for the selected payroll month. Matches Payment History UI: payment date, type, amount, status, transaction/UTR (reserved for online pay).

post.summary: Generate payroll run for an employee
post.description: Creates payroll for employee/month/year. Returns 422 if duplicate or no salary structure.

422.description: Examples: duplicate employee/month/year/company; inactive employee; no active salary structure for period.

post.summary: Bulk generate payroll runs with auto overtime
post.description: Generates payroll for all active employees in scope (or selected employee_ids). Overtime is auto-calculated from attendance and shift rules.

201.description: Bulk payroll generated with summary totals

get.description: Primary payroll UI API. screen=summary for Payroll Summary dashboard; screen=run for Run Payroll staff board (deprecated — use GET /api/v1/payroll/run-payroll/* instead); screen=all for both. Includes workflow map (wizard steps 1–4 + actions).

post.description: Marks selected draft payroll runs as processed (finalized). Omit IDs to finalize all draft runs for the month in scope.

get.description: Legacy GET. Prefer POST /api/v1/payroll/run-flow with JSON body for Save Payroll.

post.summary: Run Payroll wizard step (1–4) via POST body
post.description: Preferred for Save Payroll / Verify Salary. Send step, month, year, and employee_ids in JSON body (no query string).
Record paid amounts per employee. Use full_payment=true to pay full pending balance. Marks payroll as paid when pending is cleared.

get.summary: Run Payroll — filter panel and action URLs
get.description: Load filter dropdowns, period info, and mutation action URLs. Call once on page load; refresh when company_id changes.
Top summary cards for all employees matching filters (not paginated).
Paginated employee payroll rows with nested amounts and per-row permissions.
Lazy-load salary breakdown when a table row is expanded.

post.description: Creates one salary structure per employee. If a structure already exists for the employee_id, returns 422 — use PUT /api/v1/payroll/salary-structures/{salaryStructure} to update instead.
